Jalan Besar & Lavender

Jalan Besar & Lavender 6

  1. Must see · Wok Noodles (Char Kway Teow, Hokkien Mee, Bak Chor Mee) · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Hill Street Tai Hwa Pork Noodle

    One Michelin star since 2016; widely called Singapore's best bak chor mee, 1-2hr queues.

    #01-12 Block 466 Crawford Lane

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, Seth Lui, Eatbook.sg

  2. Worth the detour · Wok Noodles (Char Kway Teow, Hokkien Mee, Bak Chor Mee) · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Wah Kee Big Prawn Noodle

    Michelin-listed since 1951; intense all-prawn broth, the 'auntie with attitude'.

    #01-15 Pek Kio Market & Food Centre, 41A Cambridge Road

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, Daniel Food Diary, HungryGoWhere

  3. Worth the detour · Hawker & Zi Char · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Beach Road Scissors Cut Curry Rice

    Since 1930; the definitive scissor-cut Hainanese curry rice, ingredients snipped to order.

    229 Jalan Besar (Corner of Jalan Besar & Kitchener Road)

    Recommended by The Singapore Women's Weekly, Seth Lui, Her World Singapore

  4. Worth the detour · Malay & Nasi Padang · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Kitchenman Nasi Lemak

    Opened 2024, straight onto the 2025 Michelin Bib list; Malaysian-style ayam goreng berempah.

    #01-32 CT Hub, 2 Kallang Avenue

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, HungryGoWhere, Eatbook.sg

  5. Worth the detour · Hawker & Zi Char · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Kok Kee Wanton Noodle

    Cult wanton mee known for its near-soupy, lard-based chilli gravy.

    30 Foch Road, Lavender

    Recommended by Daniel Food Diary, Eatbook.sg

  6. Worth the detour · Chinese, Dim Sum & Teochew · Jalan Besar & Lavender

    Swee Choon Tim Sum Restaurant

    Since 1962; Singapore's beloved late-night dim sum institution (open till the small hours).

    183-191 Jalan Besar

    Recommended by South China Morning Post, The Honeycombers Singapore
